description.value: R&B Brewing is one of Vancouver's original craft microbreweries, operating in the historic Brewery Creek district of East Vancouver since 1997. Their Ale & Pizza House taproom pairs house-brewed artisan ales and lagers — including award-winning staples like Raven Cream Ale and Stolen Bike Lager — with a full menu of pizzas, sandwiches, and salads crafted by an in-house chef. The space is dog-friendly on the patio, kids-welcome indoors, and driven by a strong community ethos with a live code of conduct and growler fills available for take-home beer.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 21m; stands (3 spaces) at 47m; rack (6 spaces) at 85m; rack at 87m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and corroborates OSM address, brewery phone, email, and URL. The website confirms a full-service taproom and Ale & Pizza House with dine-in food and a growler station, operating since 1997. Vegan and GF options are explicitly confirmed in the FAQ and menu; no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the website text.
concerns: Website lists two phone numbers: Brewery/Order Desk at 604-874-2537 (matches OSM) and a separate Ale & Pizza House line at 604-336-0275 used for reservations. OSM only captures the brewery phone; the Ale & Pizza House number may be more useful for visiting cyclists calling ahead.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: R&B Brewing is an established, active taproom and full-service restaurant in a cycling-accessible East Vancouver neighbourhood, offering food, local craft beer, vegan/GF options, and a welcoming community atmosphere — a natural stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states 'We have LOTS of vegan snacks, salads, sandwiches & PIZZAS!' and confirms GF snacks, salads, and sandwiches (though pizzas are not GF). Menu page explicitly labels most beer, cider, and mead items as 'Vegan' and marks some items (e.g. Banditry cider, Humblebee Meadery) as 'Gluten free Vegan'
